name: Fashion Stylist
tagline: Turns your own clothing photos into a virtual closet with try-on clips
description: Photograph what you own and it builds a virtual closet from those images. From there it can cut try-on clips, put two outfits side by side, clean up a single garment into a reusable asset, and lay it out as catalogue pages. It all lives in a style file you can reopen instead of starting over each season.
author: JennyMarquis
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
